candidateAudit.title: Danke Wien! 🚀 Zwei Tage HR Inside Summit in der Hofburg liegen hinter uns. Ein Thema war überall: Automatisierung und KI in HR-Prozessen. Auf der Bühne, in den Pausen und bis spät
candidateAudit.text: Danke Wien! 🚀 Zwei Tage HR Inside Summit in der Hofburg liegen hinter uns. Ein Thema war überall: Automatisierung und KI in HR-Prozessen. Auf der Bühne, in den Pausen und bis spät in die Gespräche am Abend. Für uns war es zusätzlich ein besonderes Event: Wir standen im Finale des HR Inside Award. 🏆 Gewonnen haben am Ende Nejo und Simona Huebl. Herzlichen Glückwunsch, ihr habt es verdient! Wir fahren trotzdem mit einem richtig guten Gefühl nach Hause: Finale in starker Gesellschaft, Christian auf der Bühne und so viele inspirierende Begegnungen. 💛 Die Möglichkeiten für HR wachsen. Und damit auch die Aufgabe, sie sinnvoll zu nutzen. Genau daran arbeiten wir weiter. 🚀 Danke an für zwei großartige Tage! #HRInsideSummit #HRInsideAward #Wien #HRTech

candidateAudit.title: “We wanted to know what belonging means. We need to do something to show the people that you are exactly like me, but different, and this difference is part of you. This is a new e
candidateAudit.text: “We wanted to know what belonging means. We need to do something to show the people that you are exactly like me, but different, and this difference is part of you. This is a new energy that you are bringing to make our country better and not worse.” In our latest interview, we talked with Mexican visual artist, curator, and cultural manager Sonia Siblik to discuss her artistic journey, curatorial vision, and her work featured in the Belonging Across Borders exhibition at the Yunus Emre Institute Gallery in Vienna. 🇦🇹 With a rich background in pedagogy and therapeutic education, Sonia brings a deeply humanistic perspective to her practice. As the founder of LichTraum by Sonia Siblik and BasementArt in Vienna’s 9th district, she has dedicated years to fostering international, intercultural, and interdisciplinary collaboration across the arts. Sonia also took part in “Wir bewegen die Welt” (We Move the World) a collaborative acrylic triptych symbolizing connection, responsibility, and shared human journeys. Featuring a central heart whose delicate threads reach toward surrounding gears, a compass, and a world map, it reflects how we simultaneously inhabit and shape the systems around us. 🏷️ Buy Online: Purchase the original artworks via GalaBid at ⁠app.galabid.com/icdo⁠ (or tap the link in our bio). “Belonging Across Borders: Art as a Bridge for Memory and Reconciliation” - The Long Nights of Interculturality 2026 Location: Yunus Emre Institute Gallery, Vienna Dates: September 23, 2026 – October 20, 2026 #icdo #vienna #culture #art #viennaculture

candidateAudit.title: 📍EPIONI | ΕΠΙΟΝΗ was proud to attend the PERIFORMANCE Annual Consortium Meeting in Vienna on 9–10 September! 🤝💬It was an inspiring two days of sharing progress, exchanging insig
candidateAudit.text: 📍EPIONI | ΕΠΙΟΝΗ was proud to attend the PERIFORMANCE Annual Consortium Meeting in Vienna on 9–10 September! 🤝💬It was an inspiring two days of sharing progress, exchanging insights, and discussing how to make cancer research more participatory, inclusive, and impactful. 💡What is PERIFORMANCE about? Under the EU’s Mission on Cancer, the EU PERIFORMANCE project focuses on transforming how citizens, patients, researchers, and policymakers engage with cancer research. 🔬As cancer care rapidly evolves with new technologies, such as artificial intelligence, digital health records, and the European Health Data Space, it is essential to ensure that innovation happens responsibly and transparently. 🌐PERIFORMANCE works to: 🔹 Identify and promote innovative ways to engage patients, survivors, carers, researchers, and public stakeholders. 🔹 Address the ethical, legal, and societal implications of emerging health technologies and data use. 🔹 Leverage biobanks as vital bridge builders connecting everyday healthcare, research infrastructures, and the public with trust and transparency. Meaningful progress in cancer research depends on building strong dialogue across science and society. 🌍❤️ We are grateful to all our project partners for two days of fruitful collaboration, and we look forward to the next steps ahead! 🚀 #PERIFORMANCE #CancerMission #ResearchInfrastructures #EHDS #ELSIperspective #StakeholdersEngagement #EUResearch #HorizonEurope #Vienna

candidateAudit.text: ✨ Ho preso l’archivio nazionale delle strade e ho contato, una per una, le vie di Lecce. La buona notizia: Lecce dedica alle donne più strade della media italiana, 115 su 1.178. Quella meno buona: le tiene lontane dal centro. Entro un chilometro da Sant’Oronzo le donne sono sante, Madonne e regine; le donne del Novecento stanno a 6 chilometri. Lo scrivo da Vienna, dove le vie dell’Ottocento raccontano la stessa storia e quelle nuove una diversa. Domani vi porto a Seestadt. A quale donna dedicheresti una piazza del centro? E una via?
